variations.name: Incumbent giga-scale cell makers
variations.description: Vertically integrated giants mass-produce lithium-ion EV cells (NMC and LFP) at tens-to-hundreds of GWh per year, driving the cost declines that make EVs competitive with combustion cars.

companies.name: CATL
companies.what: World's largest EV cell maker spanning LFP (Shenxing fast-charge), NMC (Qilin), sodium-ion and condensed-matter chemistries
companies.signal: 39.2% global share of 1,187 GWh EV battery installs in 2025; only maker above 30%

companies.name: BYD FinDreams
companies.what: In-house cell arm of BYD producing Blade LFP cells for its own EVs and external customers (Tesla, Toyota)
companies.signal: 16.4% global share in 2025; 194.8 GWh installed, up 27.7% YoY

companies.name: LG Energy Solution
companies.what: Largest non-Chinese cell maker; high-nickel pouch/cylindrical plus new LFP and LMR lines via US JVs (Ultium with GM, plants with Honda, Hyundai, Stellantis)
companies.signal: #3 globally; 12.8% YoY growth in 2025 though Korean makers' combined share fell to 16%

companies.name: Panasonic Energy
companies.what: Tesla's longtime cylindrical-cell partner (2170, 4680) with Nevada and Kansas gigafactories
companies.signal: #7 globally with 3.7% share in 2025; De Soto, Kansas plant ramping

companies.name: Samsung SDI
companies.what: Prismatic NMC/NCA cells for BMW, Audi, Rivian and a Stellantis US JV (StarPlus), plus an all-solid-state pilot line
companies.signal: Top-10 globally; part of Korean trio whose combined 2025 share was 16%

companies.name: SK On
companies.what: High-nickel pouch cells for Ford (BlueOval SK), Hyundai and VW; merged with SK trading/enmove units to shore up finances
companies.signal: Top-6 globally; multiple US JV plants started production 2024-2025

companies.name: CALB
companies.what: China's #3 independent cell maker supplying LFP and NMC to GAC, Xpeng, Leapmotor and others
companies.signal: Top-5 globally by 2025 installs; HK-listed

companies.name: EVE Energy
companies.what: Chinese maker of large cylindrical (46-series) and LFP cells; technology partner (10% owner) of the US Amplify truck-cell JV
companies.signal: Top-10 globally; partner in $2-3B 21 GWh Mississippi plant

companies.name: Gotion High-Tech
companies.what: VW-backed Chinese maker pushing LFP/LMFP innovation (Astroinno L600 LMFP cell) with US and Europe plant plans
companies.signal: Top-10 globally in 2025 installs; VW is largest shareholder

companies.name: Sunwoda
companies.what: Chinese consumer-battery giant that broke into the EV top-10 with fast-charging LFP cells for Li Auto and others
companies.signal: Top-10 global EV battery maker in 2025, among the fastest-growing

variations.name: Challenger & regional cell manufacturers
variations.description: New entrants and OEM-backed ventures build gigafactories outside the China-Korea-Japan oligopoly to localize EV cell supply in Europe and North America — a capital-intensive race where several flagship players have already failed.

companies.name: Northvolt
companies.what: Europe's flagship independent cell maker (Northvolt Ett, Sweden) that raised ~$15B before collapsing under ramp-up and quality problems
companies.signal: Filed for bankruptcy in Sweden March 2025 — Sweden's largest-ever bankruptcy

companies.name: Lyten
companies.what: US lithium-sulfur developer that bought Northvolt's Swedish gigafactory and labs out of bankruptcy to run dual-track Li-ion and Li-S production
companies.signal: ~$5B deal for Northvolt Ett + Labs (16 GWh capacity) closed 2025-26; production restart planned H2 2026; ~170 ex-Northvolt staff rehired

companies.name: PowerCo (Volkswagen)
companies.what: VW's in-house cell company building a standardized 'unified cell' across plants in Salzgitter, Valencia and St. Thomas (Canada)
companies.signal: Launched production in Salzgitter in 2025 after VW wrote down its Northvolt stake

companies.name: ACC (Automotive Cells Company)
companies.what: Stellantis-Mercedes-TotalEnergies JV producing NMC cells in Douvrin, France, now pivoting toward cheaper chemistries
companies.signal: Europe's #2 cell maker; halted construction of German and Italian gigafactories June 2024 amid slowing EV demand

companies.name: Verkor
companies.what: French cell maker backed by Renault producing high-nickel cells for Renault's premium EVs
companies.signal: Raised ~$2.15B; Dunkirk gigafactory began operations in 2025

companies.name: AESC
companies.what: Envision-owned former Nissan battery unit running plants in Japan, UK, Tennessee and building in Kentucky for BMW/Mercedes/Nissan
companies.signal: Tennessee operating and Kentucky on track, but paused its $1.6B South Carolina plant June 2025 citing policy and market uncertainty

companies.name: Amplify Cell Technologies
companies.what: Accelera (Cummins)-Daimler Truck-PACCAR JV building a 21 GWh LFP cell plant in Mississippi for commercial trucks, with EVE Energy as technology partner
companies.signal: $2-3B committed; production pushed from 2027 to 2028 on weak electric-truck demand

companies.name: Britishvolt
companies.what: UK gigafactory venture that planned a 38 GWh plant in Blyth but never reached production funding
companies.signal: Collapsed into administration January 2023; successor rescue attempts failed

companies.name: FREYR Battery (now T1 Energy)
companies.what: Norwegian-US venture that licensed 24M semi-solid cell technology, then abandoned battery manufacturing entirely
companies.signal: Exited cells and rebranded as solar manufacturer T1 Energy in early 2025; Georgia battery plans dropped

variations.white_space: Northvolt, Britishvolt and FREYR show that standalone Western cell startups rarely survive the capital intensity and Chinese cost curve; the openings that remain are OEM-anchored ventures with guaranteed offtake (PowerCo, Amplify) and distressed-asset plays like Lyten's Northvolt takeover.

variations.name: Solid-state batteries
variations.description: Replacing the flammable liquid electrolyte with a solid (sulfide, oxide-ceramic or polymer) promises higher energy density and safety, and is now moving from lab to B-samples in demo vehicles and first giga-level plants.

companies.name: QuantumScape
companies.what: Anode-free lithium-metal cell with ceramic separator; licensing model with VW's PowerCo rather than self-manufacturing
companies.signal: Shipped QSE-5 B1 samples 2025; higher-throughput Cobra separator process and 'Eagle Line' inaugurated Feb 2026

companies.name: Solid Power
companies.what: Sulfide solid-electrolyte developer selling electrolyte material and licensing cell designs (BMW, SK On)
companies.signal: BMW i7 demo vehicle running its cells; joint evaluation agreement with Samsung SDI + BMW; electrolyte pilot line commissioning 2026

companies.name: Factorial Energy
companies.what: Quasi-solid FEST and all-solid-state Solstice cells designed to run on existing lithium-ion production equipment
companies.signal: Backed by Mercedes-Benz, Stellantis and Hyundai; Mercedes EQS road-tested its solid-state pack in 2025

companies.name: ProLogium
companies.what: Taiwanese maker of lithium-ceramic oxide cells running the world's first giga-level solid-state factory (Taoyuan) and building a €5.2B Dunkirk plant
companies.signal: Dunkirk groundbreaking done, mass production targeted 2028 ramping to 4 GWh by 2029; unveiled 'superfluidized' all-inorganic cell at CES 2026

companies.name: Toyota
companies.what: Largest corporate solid-state program (with Idemitsu on sulfide electrolyte), targeting first production vehicles around 2027-28
companies.signal: Re-confirmed 2027 rollout target on its battery roadmap

companies.name: Samsung SDI
companies.what: Sulfide all-solid-state (ASB) pilot line in Suwon producing samples for automakers
companies.signal: Targeting 2027 mass production of all-solid-state cells

companies.name: WeLion New Energy
companies.what: Chinese maker of semi-solid (hybrid electrolyte) cells already shipping in NIO's 150 kWh swappable pack
companies.signal: Semi-solid packs in commercial use with NIO since 2024 — the first road-going 'solid-state-adjacent' EV cells

companies.name: Blue Solutions (Bolloré)
companies.what: Only company with years of commercial polymer solid-state cells in service (Mercedes eCitaro buses), now developing a gen-4 EV cell
companies.signal: Decade of fleet deployment in buses and car-sharing; gen-4 plant planned in France

variations.name: Lithium-metal & anode-free cells
variations.description: Replacing the graphite anode with thin lithium metal — or no anode at all — can boost energy density 50-100%, but dendrite growth and manufacturing yield have killed or redirected most ventures.

companies.name: SES AI
companies.what: MIT spinout whose Li-metal EV A-sample program morphed into an AI materials-discovery platform (Molecular Universe) plus drone and ESS battery sales
companies.signal: NYSE-listed; pivoted factories to drones; ~10x sales growth with 2025 revenue guidance of $15-25M — EV li-metal effectively deprioritized

companies.name: Ion Storage Systems
companies.what: Anode-free, compression-free ceramic solid-state cell using a 3D garnet electrolyte structure (University of Maryland spinout)
companies.signal: First multilayer cells off semi-automated Beltsville line March 2025; $20M ARPA-E SCALEUP award; first customer qualification with production starting 2025

companies.name: Pure Lithium
companies.what: Vertically integrated lithium-metal-on-LFP cell with a brine-to-anode extraction process that skips conventional lithium refining
companies.signal: 150+ patents/applications; claims Gen-1 Li-LFP cell with 2x LFP energy density and 6,500+ cycles

companies.name: Sion Power
companies.what: Arizona developer of large-format Licerion lithium-metal cells for EV and defense applications
companies.signal: Long-running program (ex Li-S pioneer); current commercial traction unclear as of 2026

variations.white_space: This space is thinning, not crowding: Northvolt shut its Cuberg li-metal unit (2024) and SES pivoted to software/drones, evidence that dendrite suppression plus manufacturable yield remains unsolved economics; the opening is defense- and aviation-funded niches where $/kWh matters less than Wh/kg, and anode-free architectures that piggyback on solid-state separators (Ion Storage, QuantumScape).

variations.name: Silicon-anode cell makers
variations.description: Swapping graphite for silicon-dominant anodes stores far more lithium per gram, yielding 20-80% higher energy density and faster charge — first commercialized in drones, defense and wearables where buyers pay premiums.

companies.name: Amprius Technologies
companies.what: Highest-energy-density commercial cells (SiCore/SiMaxx, up to 450-500 Wh/kg) built on a silicon nanowire/silicon-dominant platform for UAVs, e-aviation and defense
companies.signal: NYSE-listed; $15M UAV purchase order Feb 2025; GWh-scale contract-manufacturing network; 450 Wh/kg SiCore launched May 2025

companies.name: Enovix
companies.what: 3D-stacked cell architecture with 100% active silicon anode, ramping in Malaysia (Fab2) for smartphones/wearables with EV as a later market
companies.signal: AI-1 smartphone cell (900+ Wh/L) in commercial qualification; raised $232M via warrants in 2025 to accelerate Fab2

companies.name: Ionblox
companies.what: Pre-lithiated silicon-oxide pouch cells delivering both high power and fast charge, aimed at eVTOL aircraft and extreme-fast-charge EVs
companies.signal: Series B expanded to $32M with Temasek, Applied Ventures and Lilium; ~$60M total raised

companies.name: NanoGraf
companies.what: Chicago maker of silicon-anode 18650 cells (M38, 3.8 Ah) for US military radios and equipment, onshoring the full cell supply chain
companies.signal: ~$45M cumulative DoD funding incl. $15M Army contract; tens of thousands of M38 cells produced 2024, scaling to hundreds of thousands in 2025; Thales design win

variations.white_space: Full silicon-anode cells at EV scale remain open territory — current players profitably serve drones/defense/consumer niches while EV silicon arrives mainly as anode-material blends from suppliers (Sila, Group14, in the Components bucket); whoever cracks automotive-grade cycle life and GWh cost first inherits a large premium-EV and eVTOL market.

variations.name: Lithium-sulfur cells
variations.description: Sulfur cathodes are dirt-cheap, abundant and free of nickel/cobalt, with 2-3x theoretical energy density of lithium-ion, but polysulfide shuttling has historically destroyed cycle life — a physics problem several startups now claim to have engineered around.

companies.name: Lyten
companies.what: 3D-graphene-caged sulfur cathode Li-S cells; now also owns Northvolt's Swedish plants for dual lithium-ion/Li-S production
companies.signal: A-samples shipped to US/EU automakers from San Jose pilot line; >$1B Reno gigafactory (10 GWh) planned with phase 1 targeted 2027; Stellantis strategic investor

companies.name: Zeta Energy
companies.what: Houston startup pairing a sulfurized-carbon cathode with a lithium-metal anode, claiming ~3x energy density at half the cost of li-ion
companies.signal: Joint development agreement with Stellantis (Dec 2024) targeting EV application by 2030

companies.name: Theion
companies.what: Berlin startup using monoclinic sulfur crystal cathodes grown directly, targeting 3x energy density at a fraction of cell cost
companies.signal: Founded 2020; venture-stage with aerospace/mobility sample ambitions

companies.name: Li-S Energy
companies.what: ASX-listed Australian developer of semi-solid-state Li-S cells with boron-nitride nanotube stabilization, focused on drones and defense aviation
companies.signal: ASX:LIS; 45 Ah cells produced on its Geelong pilot line

companies.name: OXIS Energy
companies.what: UK Li-S pioneer with aviation and marine programs that ran out of cash before commercialization
companies.signal: Entered administration May 2021; IP sold (largely to Gelion) — the sector's cautionary tale

companies.name: Stellantis
companies.what: Only major automaker betting on Li-S twice over — strategic investor in Lyten (2023) and JDA partner of Zeta Energy
companies.signal: Targets Li-S EV batteries around 2030 to cut pack cost and weight

variations.white_space: Barely a handful of credible players because polysulfide shuttle and lithium-metal anodes compound two unsolved problems; OXIS's collapse and Lyten's pivot toward conventional li-ion (via Northvolt assets) show the funding gap — the opening is weight-critical aviation, drone and defense markets that tolerate 200-500 cycle lives while cycle life improves.

variations.name: Sodium-ion for mobility
variations.description: Sodium-ion cells swap lithium for abundant sodium, promising lower cost, no lithium/cobalt/copper exposure and excellent cold-weather and fast-charge behavior at ~10-20% lower energy density — now entering first mass production for cars in China.

companies.name: CATL
companies.what: Naxtra sodium-ion brand (175 Wh/kg, -40°C operation) plus hybrid sodium-lithium packs via dual-power architecture
companies.signal: Naxtra launched April 2025, mass production from Dec 2025; first sodium EV (Changan Nevo A06) due mid-2026

companies.name: HiNa Battery
companies.what: Chinese Academy of Sciences spinout that put sodium-ion cells in the first test EV (Sehol E10X) and supplies low-speed vehicles and ESS
companies.signal: Small-batch production since 2023; among China's sodium-ion leaders

companies.name: BYD
companies.what: Building a dedicated sodium-ion plant (Xuzhou) targeting small EVs and micromobility alongside its LFP empire
companies.signal: Confirmed sodium-ion development; deployment expected in select models behind CATL's timeline

companies.name: Faradion
companies.what: UK sodium-ion pioneer with layered-oxide cathode chemistry now owned by Reliance Industries for the Indian market
companies.signal: Acquired by Reliance Industries 2022 (~£100M); no automotive-scale production announced

companies.name: Tiamat Energy
companies.what: French CNRS spinout making high-power polyanionic sodium-ion cells (power tools first, mobility next) with a planned Amiens gigafactory
companies.signal: Backed by Stellantis Ventures, Arkema, MBDA; third funding round closed June 2025; 5 GWh plant construction starting late 2025, output ~2027

companies.name: Farasis Energy
companies.what: Chinese pouch-cell maker that put first-gen sodium-ion cells into JMEV city EVs and is shipping gen-2
companies.signal: Sodium-ion EVs on Chinese roads since 2023; gen-2 cells at ~160 Wh/kg

companies.name: Natron Energy
companies.what: US Prussian-blue sodium-ion maker (industrial/data-center power, adjacent to mobility) that could not bridge to scale
companies.signal: Ceased all operations Sept 2025; 95 laid off; $1.4B North Carolina gigafactory cancelled

variations.white_space: Outside China the field is nearly empty — Natron's liquidation and Faradion's quiet absorption into Reliance show sodium-ion's cost advantage only materializes at giga-scale when lithium prices are high; the opening is Western low-cost regional EVs, two/three-wheelers and cold-climate fleets if anyone can finance a plant before CATL's exports set the price floor.

variations.name: LFP/LMFP & manganese-rich cell innovation
variations.description: Iron- and manganese-based cathodes trade some energy density for major cost, safety and longevity gains; adding manganese (LMFP, LMR) claws back 15-33% energy density, making this the chemistry battleground for mass-market EVs.

companies.name: CATL
companies.what: Shenxing superfast-charge LFP family (4C, later 800 km/12C peak versions) mass-produced for dozens of Chinese models
companies.signal: Shenxing in volume production since 2024 across major Chinese OEMs

companies.name: BYD FinDreams
companies.what: Blade 2.0 LFP cells and the Super e-Platform claiming 10C megawatt 'flash charging' (~400 km in 5 minutes)
companies.signal: 1,000 kW flash-charge platform unveiled March 2025, rolling out on Han L/Tang L

companies.name: Gotion High-Tech
companies.what: First mover in LMFP with the Astroinno L600 cell (240 Wh/kg, ~1000 km pack range) headed for series production
companies.signal: Astroinno LMFP validated and slated for volume production; VW-backed

companies.name: Ultium Cells (GM + LG Energy Solution)
companies.what: First Western program to commercialize lithium-manganese-rich (LMR) prismatic cells — 33% higher energy density than best LFP at comparable cost — for electric trucks/SUVs
companies.signal: Pre-production at LG facility late 2027, US commercial production 2028

companies.name: Ford
companies.what: Ion Park team developing its own LMR chemistry and licensing CATL LFP tech for the BlueOval Battery Park Michigan plant
companies.signal: Declared intent to put LMR cells in EVs this decade; Michigan LFP plant ramping 2026

companies.name: Our Next Energy (ONE)
companies.what: Michigan startup behind Aries LFP packs and the Gemini dual-chemistry (LFP + anode-free range extender) architecture
companies.signal: Lost key EV contract; 45% workforce cut Jan 2026; abandoned automotive to focus on rail, defense and grid storage with $35M in new contracts

companies.name: Integrals Power
companies.what: UK developer of high-manganese (up to 80% Mn) LMFP cathode materials and prototype cells for automotive customers
companies.signal: Seed/early-stage; supplying LMFP samples to OEM and cell-maker evaluations

variations.white_space: Chinese incumbents own LFP innovation end-to-end; the Western gap is stark — ONE's retreat from automotive leaves GM/LG's 2028 LMR program as the main non-Chinese bet, so an opening exists for US/EU LFP-LMFP cell capacity insulated by tariffs and defense/rail demand rather than head-on EV price competition.

variations.name: Extreme-fast-charge & niobium/LTO cells
variations.description: Niobium- and titanium-oxide anodes (and silicon-dominant XFC designs) charge in under 10 minutes and survive tens of thousands of cycles, targeting vehicles and machines where uptime beats energy density.

companies.name: StoreDot
companies.what: Israeli silicon-dominant '100in5' XFC cells (100 miles in 5 minutes), with prismatic samples produced with Flex|N|Gate and EVE Energy as manufacturing partner
companies.signal: 15 OEM test programs incl. 5 of top-10 automakers; Andretti SPAC merger signed Dec 2025 then cancelled in 2026 over a $30M cash shortfall — reportedly months of runway left

companies.name: Nyobolt
companies.what: Cambridge (UK) niobium-tungsten-oxide anode cells charging in under 5 minutes with very long cycle life, first commercialized in warehouse robotics
companies.signal: $60M Series C led by Symbotic at ~$1B valuation (2025); ~$160M total raised; EV demonstrator charged 10-80% in 4m37s

companies.name: Echion Technologies
companies.what: Cambridge maker of XNO niobium-oxide anode materials that drop into partner cells for 6-minute-charge mining trucks, buses and industrial EVs
companies.signal: GWh-scale XNO supply partnership with niobium giant CBMM; commercial cells shipping via partners

companies.name: Toshiba
companies.what: SCiB lithium-titanate (LTO) cells with 20,000+ cycle life powering buses, trains, ships and grid buffers for nearly two decades; next-gen NTO (niobium-titanium-oxide) cell with CBMM/Sojitz
companies.signal: SCiB commercially deployed since 2008 across transport fleets; NTO samples demonstrated

companies.name: Microvast
companies.what: Fast-charging cell and pack maker for commercial vehicles (buses, trucks, port equipment) with plants in China, Germany and Tennessee
companies.signal: NASDAQ-listed; thousands of commercial fleets equipped; >$300M annual revenue scale

variations.white_space: Standalone XFC startups are being squeezed from above — CATL's 4C-6C Shenxing and BYD's 10C flash-charge LFP now ship at giga-scale, which is exactly why StoreDot is on the brink; the surviving opening is high-cycle-count niche duty cycles (robotics, mining, ports, charging buffers) where niobium/LTO chemistry's 10x cycle life justifies its $/kWh premium, as Nyobolt and Echion are proving.

variations.name: High-power specialty cells for e-aviation & performance
variations.description: Electric aircraft, eVTOLs and motorsport need cells that discharge at 10-20C (and recharge between flights) without overheating — a low-volume, high-margin niche dominated by one Taiwanese supplier after the leading startup died.

companies.name: Molicel (E-One Moli Energy)
companies.what: Taiwan Cement subsidiary whose P45B/P50B/P60 21700 cells (up to 100 A continuous, 250-300 Wh/kg) are the de facto standard for eVTOL, motorsport and high-end drones
companies.signal: P60 released 2025; supplies multiple eVTOL and electric-aviation programs (e.g. Dovetail Electric Aviation); new Kaohsiung capacity online

companies.name: Cuberg
companies.what: Berkeley lithium-metal cell startup focused on aviation, acquired by Northvolt in 2021 as its advanced-technology arm
companies.signal: Shut down October 2024 (196 laid off) as Northvolt retrenched; li-metal R&D moved to Sweden and died with Northvolt's bankruptcy

companies.name: Amprius Technologies
companies.what: Silicon-anode cells with the highest specific energy in flight use — powering HAPS (high-altitude pseudo-satellites), military UAVs and eVTOL prototypes
companies.signal: Airbus Zephyr heritage; $15M UAV order 2025; SiCore 450 Wh/kg launched for aviation/defense

companies.name: EaglePicher Technologies
companies.what: US defense/aerospace battery house (Missouri) building qualified high-power and thermal cells for missiles, aircraft and space programs
companies.signal: Decades of DoD/NASA flight heritage; expanding lithium-ion aviation lines

companies.name: Saft (TotalEnergies)
companies.what: French specialty-cell maker supplying certified high-power lithium cells for aviation, satellites, rail and defense
companies.signal: Cells flying on commercial aircraft (A350 backup), satellites and rail fleets worldwide

variations.white_space: Cuberg's shutdown and the insolvency of anchor customers like Lilium left e-aviation cell supply concentrated in Molicel; aerospace certification costs and tiny volumes deter giga-scale incumbents, so the opening is defense- and certification-funded specialty lines (the Amprius/NanoGraf playbook) selling Wh/kg and C-rate at 5-10x automotive cell prices.
